objective: Join the current typed operational-surface inventory losslessly and emit exactly one terminal record per stable control across the required thirteen interaction-chain stages without exercising unadmitted effects.
implemented: The helper reads and SHA-256 binds registry/operational_surface_inventory.json before the walker attaches to a live host.

It rejects invalid schema/identity, empty inventory, duplicate surfaces, duplicate control IDs, per-surface count drift, or per-surface stable-ID hash drift without hard-coding a surface or control count.
It follows the current predecessor-bound inventory authority dynamically; the current input contains twenty surfaces and 845 stable controls.

Every current stable control receives one sorted terminal record and exactly thirteen timestamped stage records: open/load, display, user edit/action, input validation, authorization, backend dispatch, runtime effect, progress reporting, result acknowledgement, persistence, reload/reopen, failure handling, and recovery/rollback.
Potentially mutating controls conservatively receive exact run authority, an effect-specific reason, and a machine-checkable return condition. No skipped control is silently omitted.
The walker records exact attempted navigation/toggle stable IDs and rejects any attempted ID absent from the inventory.
The native pacifyX.openDashboard bootstrap command now has a stable inventory ID and is recorded as attempted after the dashboard materializes.

Agent and Workflow builder automation is disabled until its individual controls have pre-state, post-state, cleanup, and stable-ID evidence; the prior aggregate builder delta cannot be misreported as per-control verification.

Installed/source identity mismatch is detected before surface traversal. It blocks all further navigation and builder interaction while still emitting a terminal blocked record for every inventory control.
Runtime action observations now retain bounded data-* variant attributes so row, kind, scope, tab, direction, and lifecycle variants can be resolved without collapsing identity to data-action alone.
